posts.body_html:
In the grand scheme of things, there's only a few things in life that truly matter. Now you're probably thinking that because of the powerful name of this cultivar, perhaps that conjures deep philosophical thoughts that most growers would otherwise not see. Either that, or MW is going on one of his koo-koo rants and the real purpose of this whole mumbo jumbo is to say "NERD ALERT!!! NERD ALERT!!!!!!

Please note, I did take off my gold chain and oversized clock before taking this photo:


Immediately, my wife said something to the extent of "Haaaaay.....your clone suuuuucks, the one in the shirt looks better!" I instantly whooped her attempt to belittle my cropz by explaining to her that those traps just opened, and they'll color up as they age! Everyone knows that, GOSH!

Still, this clone is quite pretty even when not fully colored upL:
